newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks mixed in moderate volume.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks mixed in moderate volume.

text.p: The Dow Jones Industrial Average slid slightly lower on Monday in a pull back from last week's record-breaking run.
The Dow shed about five points to 7777 in late morning trading while the technology stocks rebounded higher. Technology-heavy Nasdaq gained about two points to 1425.
Analysts said the market was most likely pausing after an unexpectedly strong rally last week in which the Dow rose about 346 points.
The long bond gained 8/32, its yield at 6.71 percent. The Standard & Poor's futures index was off 0.05 to 903.40.
